name: Rhino

prerequisites.note: Standard new-player opening; unlocks Earth and the star chart.

prerequisites.name: Venus Junction (on Earth)
prerequisites.note: Tasks: complete The Teacher, equip Dreamer's Bond in the aura slot, upgrade Dreamer's Bond, start building a Taxon Sentinel, complete the Junction. Unlocks Venus.

prerequisites.name: Fossa, Venus
prerequisites.note: Reached along the Venus chain E Gate > Fortuna > Kiliken > Fossa.

prerequisites.name: 35,000 credits
prerequisites.note: Market price of the main Rhino blueprint.

routes.notes: 35,000 credits. Only source of the main blueprint outside The Circuit.

routes.where: Fossa, Venus - Assassination (Jackal, spawns at level 8)
routes.notes: Table sums to 100%; every clear yields exactly one component blueprint. Systems is the bottleneck at 22.56%.

routes.where: The Circuit (Duviri) - Normal mode, Week 2 of the 12-week rotation
conditions: Rhino must be the frame you pick that week (offered alongside Loki and Mag)
Week 2 of the rotation must be live
routes.notes: Deterministic tier rewards, not a drop roll, so dropRate is null by design. Rhino's week also grants the Ironclad Charge augment.

Rhino (final).note: Wiki lists 'Time: 1 Day(s)' for the main frame.

buildTimes.criticalPathNote: All three components can build in parallel, so 12h + 24h if the parts are in hand.

effortWhy: One low-level boss with a 100%-component table; a handful of Fossa runs plus a 35k credit blueprint.
gotchas: Systems is 22.56% against 38.72% for the other two, so it is usually the last piece and the reason a run count balloons.
The main blueprint is a Market purchase; killing Jackal forever will never drop it.
Killing the Jackal is also a Venus Junction (the one on Venus that unlocks Mercury) task, so the farm overlaps with normal star-chart progression.
You need a free Warframe slot before the Foundry will let you claim the finished frame.
The Circuit route only offers Rhino on week 2 of a 12-week rotation and only if you pick him over Loki and Mag that week.

community.painLevel: very low; treated as one of the two or three easiest frames to acquire
community.recommendedMode: Solo, normal star chart. Jackal spawns at level 8, so no group or Steel Path benefit; Steel Path is not a condition on the drop table.
community.preferredRoute: Boss route (Fossa Jackal) for the three components plus the 35,000-credit Market blueprint. The Circuit is a fallback only when Rhino's week is live and you pick him over Loki and Mag.
community.timeEstimate: ~3+ Jackal runs typical, more with bad Systems RNG. No hour figures reported.
traps: Fossa can show as a high-level node when a Nightmare Mode or Invasion variant is overlaid. Click the node and pick the plain Assassination version.
Re-running Fossa for the main blueprint never works; it is a Market purchase only. Most-repeated wasted-time report in the threads.
The node occasionally fails on load; re-queue rather than restarting.
tips: Break a leg during the stagger phase; new players report doing zero damage and assuming they are underpowered.
Fossa is on the left side of the Venus map near the Junction.
Rhino Prime is vaulted; its relics come only from Varzia (Prime Resurgence) for Aya. Check for an unvaulting before farming Aya.
community.sentiment: Effective but simple; some suggest Koumei as an early frame that teaches more mechanics. Nobody disputes Rhino works.
sources: r/Warframe Rhino-farming beginner threads and a frequently reposted early-frame acquisition list

conflicts.wikiClaim: Jackal spawns at level 8 on Fossa, Venus, with no Nightmare or Steel Path condition on the Rhino drop table.
conflicts.communityClaim: Players repeatedly find Fossa displayed as a high-level node and assume Rhino is gated behind harder content.
conflicts.why: Both are true at once: the base Assassination is level 8, and the high-level display is a Nightmare or Invasion overlay on the same node. Show the wiki level and surface the overlay as a trap.

discarded.claim: Forum reports of 25-40+ Jackal runs with no Systems drop, and of Jackal 'not dropping' Systems at all.
discarded.why: Posts date from the 2013-2016 drop-table era and predate the current table. The wiki table sums to 100% with Systems at 22.56%, so a component drops every clear. Kept only as an anecdote that RNG streaks happen.

discarded.claim: Jackal has a Steel Path variant relevant to Rhino farming.
discarded.why: The wiki Jackal page does not describe one, and no Steel Path condition appears on the Rhino drop table. Reported as absent rather than guessed.

discarded.claim: Community: Koumei is the better early frame to farm instead of Rhino.
discarded.why: Taste, not acquisition. Kept in community.sentiment only; it changes no route, cost or effort figure.

unknowns.note: No day/night, Fass/Vome, spiral or Steel Path condition applies to the Jackal fight per the wiki.
Circuit tier rewards are deterministic picks, so no numeric rate exists to report.
